test_objective: Check that an entity can be retrieved asking for a non-existent linked entity
keywords: Retrieve Entity With Non Existent Linked Entity

test_cases.name: 018_14_01 Inline
test_cases.doc: Check that an entity can be retrieved asking for a non-existent linked entity
test_cases.template: Retrieve Entity With Non Existent Linked Entity
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Query Entity with Response Status Code set to 200     and
        Query Entity with Check Response Body Content and
            Query Parameter: expectation_filename set to 'linked-entity-retrieval/building-non-existent-inline-flat-018-14.json' and
            Query Parameter: response_body set to 'response.json()' and
            Query Parameter: additional_ignored_path set to '${EMPTY}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${linking_entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: join set to 'inline' and
    Query Parameter: joinLevel set to '1' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"'
}
